body: The cohort view alone would justify the plan. We currently paste screenshots of the spreadsheet into a slide nobody trusts.
Please include net revenue retention — churn and expansion in one line is the number our board asks for first.
Confirmed for the analytics revamp. CSV export rides along — no point building a dashboard you cannot audit.
Would love a per-board opt-in. I do not need every integration board ping, but feature requests should page me.
Shipped and it is glorious. Our board now matches our brand kit without a support ticket.
Used the merge for the first time this week — three dark-mode duplicates became one post with the votes pooled. Exactly right.
Seconded. A single 'account tier' dropdown would let us weight votes from enterprise separately.
Monday 9am local time, please. Anything later is Tuesday in practice.
Understood, but even read-only API scopes would unblock us in the meantime.
Fair ask — we will revisit read-only endpoints after the multi-workspace split lands. Not forgotten.
Seeing the same drift on the roadmap cards. Repro: vote from the list view, then open detail.
Root cause found — counter write and event read race on the same row. Fix in the pipeline branch now.
Lost a comment the same way. localStorage draft restore would have saved it.
The issue chip on the roadmap card is the part that sells it internally — execs click through to GitHub and believe it.
Column mapping is the whole game: board, title, body, date, and a vote-count column would cover our sheet exactly.
This made my week. The changelog stays.
Amplifying this one — last bright tab left in my workspace.
Repro'd on iPhone 14, Safari 17. Works fine in Chrome.
